title: Wiggle Little Toes
text:
Wiggle, wiggle, little toes,
Tap them soft where the sunshine goes.
Clap your hands and touch your nose,
Up we stretch, and down we close!

Hop like a bunny, one, two, three,
Buzz like a bumble on a tree.
Spin around and count to four,
Then tiptoe softly to the door.

Yawn a yawn and hug your bear,
Sleepy stars are everywhere.
Wiggle, wiggle, little toes,
Goodnight, goodnight, off she goes.

title: Wiggle Little Toes
text:
Wiggle, wiggle, little toes,
Tap them where the sunshine goes!
Clap your hands and count to three,
One, two, three — now dance with me!

Stretch up tall like apple trees,
Sway your branches in the breeze.
Hop like bunnies, soft and slow,
Round and round the garden go!

Now we tiptoe, quiet mouse,
Sleepy fingers, sleepy house.
Yawn a yawn and hug a bear,
Goodnight toes and goodnight hair!

title: Wiggle Little Toes
text:
Wiggle, wiggle, little toes,
Tap them softly, off we go!
Clap your hands and count to three,
One, two, three — now wiggle with me!

Stretch your arms up to the sky,
Wave hello as clouds float by.
Spin around and touch the ground,
Jump up high without a sound!

Wiggle, wiggle, little toes,
Time to rest now, off we doze.

title: Four Little Seasons
text:
Spring brings raindrops, plip-plop-plee,
Little green buds on every tree.
Summer sun is warm and bright,
Fireflies blinking in the night.
Autumn leaves go swish and swirl,
Red and yellow, twist and twirl.
Winter snow falls soft and slow,
Mittens on and out we go!
Round and round the seasons play,
Here comes another sunny day!

title: Soup Pot Bubble
text:
Stir the soup pot, round and round,
Bubble, bubble, what a sound!
In go carrots, orange and sweet,
In go noodles, curly treat.
Sprinkle pepper, one, two, three,
Stir it slow and count with me.
Blow it cool and take a sip,
Warm and happy, drip drip drip!
Soup pot bubble, soup pot hum,
Supper's ready — everyone come!

title: The Rain Goes Pitter-Pat
text:
The rain goes pitter, pitter-pat,
It taps upon my yellow hat.
The wind goes whoosh and swirls around,
And swishes leaves along the ground.

The sun peeks out and says hello,
And paints a great big colored bow.
The puddles shine, the sky is blue,
So splash and stomp and jump right through!

Pitter-pat and whoosh and shine,
Every kind of day is fine!

title: Pancake Pat
text:
Pancake Pat has pancakes three,
One for you and two for me!
Flip them high, flip them low,
Watch that pancake pop and go!

Berries red and butter gold,
Eat them up before they're cold.
Sticky fingers, happy grins,
Lick the syrup off our chins!

Pancake Pat says, "Have some more!"
Stack them up right through the door!

title: Sunny Says Good Morning
text:
Sunny peeks in, bright and new,
Hop right up, the day says "Boo!"
Stretch your arms and touch the sky,
Wave to sleepy clouds bye-bye.

Splash-splash water on my nose,
Brush my teeth in tidy rows.
One sock, two socks, shirt goes on,
Wiggle till the buttons're done.

Spoon and bowl and one big grin,
Breakfast time, let's dig right in!
Out the door and off I go —
Good morning, world, hello, hello!

title: Deep Green Woods
text:
Tall green trees stand in a row,
Mossy paths where mushrooms grow.
Hop a log and count to three,
A bushy squirrel waves at me!

Owl says whoo from way up high,
Ferns go swish as we walk by.
Acorns tumble, plip-plop-plunk,
Rabbit hides behind a trunk.

Wave goodbye to every tree,
The woods will wait for you and me!

title: The Wind Went Whooshing By
text:
The wind went whooshing, whoosh, whoosh, whoosh,
It tickled every leafy bush.
It spun the leaves around my feet,
And danced them down the busy street.

It puffed my hat up in the air,
It made a mess of Grandma's hair!
It pushed the clouds across the blue,
Then whooshed a little kiss at you.

So hold my hand and skip along,
And hum the wind's whoosh-whooshing song!

title: Hop Out of Bed
text:
Hop out of bed and stretch up tall,
Say good morning to the wall!
Splash the water, wash my face,
Brush my teeth all over the place.

Shirt goes on, one arm, then two,
Wiggle, wiggle, in my shoe.
Brush my hair and grab my cup,
Gulp, gulp, gulp — I'm all filled up!

Zip my coat and out the door,
Morning, morning, hop some more!

title: Grandma's Rocking Chair
text:
Grandma has a rocking chair,
Rock-a-rock, we sit right there.
Grandpa hums a sleepy tune,
Hum-a-hum, beneath the moon.
Mama brings us cups of milk,
Warm and soft and smooth as silk.
Papa tells a story slow,
Whispers low, then off we go.
Baby claps her tiny hands,
Clap-a-clap, the whole house stands!
One big family, tucked in tight,
Hug-a-hug and say goodnight.

title: Moon Balloon
text:
A little moon balloon floats up so high,
It tugs a silver string across the sky.
It bumps the sleepy clouds and says goodnight,
Then tucks each twinkly star in soft and tight.

So close your eyes and hold the string with me,
We'll drift above the hills and past the sea.
The moon balloon will rock us to and fro,
And hum a little tune so sweet and low.

Goodnight, balloon. Goodnight, the sleepy sky.
Goodnight, my dear — the stars are saying bye.

title: Snowman Melts to Spring
text:
Snowman standing round and white,
Waves goodbye and melts one night.
Up pops green in every row,
Tiny flowers on their toes!

Summer sun says, "Splash with me!"
Toes go squishy in the sea.
Then the leaves turn red and gold,
Crunch, crunch, crunch! The air is cold.

Round and round the seasons go,
Flower, sunshine, leaf, and snow!

title: Barnyard Wake-Up Song
text:
The rooster crows a wobbly tune,
The cow says moo beneath the moon.
The piggy wiggles in the mud,
The duckling splashes with a thud.

The sheep goes baa, the bees go buzz,
The kitten purrs in soft warm fuzz.
The puppy wags her happy tail,
The pony trots along the trail.

So clap your hands and stomp your feet,
And sing the barnyard song so sweet!

title: Bubbles in the Yard
text:
Dip the wand and blow, blow, blow,
Watch the shiny bubbles go!
One floats high and one floats low,
Pop them with a toe, toe, toe!

Chase them round the apple tree,
Catch a bubble, one, two, three!
Big ones wobble, small ones spin,
Here's a bubble on my chin!

Blow again and count them all,
Bubbles bouncing like a ball!

title: Little Green Garden
text:
Dig a little hole, pat it nice and flat,
Drop a little seed and give the dirt a pat.
Sprinkle, sprinkle water, one, two, three,
Now the sleepy seed dreams a leafy dream with me.
Up comes a stem, so wobbly and small,
Up comes a leaf, then a stem grows tall!
Busy bumblebee buzzes past my nose,
Tickly little worm wiggles by my toes.
Carrots in a row and beans upon a vine,
One for you, and one for you, and one for mine!

title: Hello, Little Season
text:
Hello, little raindrop, tapping on my shoe,
Spring is here to wake the world, and I say hello too!
Hello, little sunbeam, warm upon my nose,
Summer buzzes softly where the sleepy flower grows.
Hello, little apple, rolling off the tree,
Autumn drops a crunchy leaf and hands it right to me.
Hello, little snowflake, quiet as a mouse,
Winter tucks a blanket on the rooftop of my house.
Round and round the seasons go, one and two and three,
Hello, hello, four times more, and back around to me!

title: Weather Wheel Turns
text:
Drip, drip, drop, the sky is gray,
Grab your boots and splash away!
Whoosh, the clouds go rolling out,
Sunshine gives a golden shout.
Crackle-boom, the thunder plays,
Hide inside for just three days—
No! Just one, and then we see
A rainbow smiling down at me.
Snow comes soft, then sun comes back,
Round and round the weather track!
